entries.visibleTitle: KATSEYE Really Did THIS for Their Music Videos 😳
entries.ogTitle: KATSEYE Really Did THIS for Their Music Videos 😳

outcome.title: KATSEYE Really Did THIS for Their Music Videos 😳
outcome.description:
Have you noticed how KATSEYE goes completely all-out when it comes to their music videos?

While most artists rely heavily on CGI, these girls actually put themselves in the action. Take “Touch,” for example. That huge chandelier crashing down wasn’t just CGI. They filmed it as a practical effect in one take, using real breakaway glass. No green screen.

Then there’s the “Gabriela” Music video. The girls were genuinely tossing props at one another using sugar glass, while a special tube sprayed fake blood to make Megan’s nose look like it was bleeding badly.

And their debut MV might be the craziest example. They weren’t simply edited onto the sides of those buildings. They were secured in harnesses and suspended at extreme heights.

#KATSEYE #Kpop #GirlGroup

outcome.description:
#JournalistRosy #Rosy #DelhiPolice #ACP #VivekBhagat #JantarMantar #JournalistDetained #FIR #MLC #MedicalExamination #PressFreedom #MediaRights #DelhiProtest #GroundReport #ExclusiveReport #DelhiNews #BreakingNews #HindiNews #Journalism #DharmendraSingh #OnlineNewsIndia


महिला पत्रकार Rosy और उनके साथी पत्रकारों को हिरासत में लिए जाने के बाद भी उनकी FIR, मेडिकल जांच और रिहाई को लेकर सवाल बने हुए हैं। पत्रकारों और उनके वकीलों का आरोप है कि हिरासत में लिए जाने के कई घंटे बाद तक उनका मेडिकल नहीं कराया गया और उन्हें एक अस्पताल से दूसरे स्थान पर भेजा जाता रहा।

Rosy का आरोप है कि जंतर-मंतर पर ज्ञानेश कुमार के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन के दौरान ACP Vivek Bhagat ने उनके साथ बदसलूकी की और अनुचित तरीके से छुआ। उनका कहना है कि शिकायत देने के बावजूद FIR दर्ज नहीं की गई। वहीं साथी पत्रकारों का दावा है कि हिरासत के दौरान उनके साथ मारपीट की गई और अब मेडिकल जांच में भी देरी की जा रही है।

इस Exclusive Ground Report में Online News India ने मौके पर मौजूद पत्रकारों, वकीलों और संबंधित लोगों से बातचीत की है। वीडियो में जानिए—पत्रकारों को पुलिस कब छोड़ेगी, वकील किन मांगों पर अड़े हैं, अभी तक MLC क्यों नहीं हुई, FIR दर्ज करने में देरी क्यों हो रही है और इस पूरे मामले पर पत्रकारों का क्या कहना है।


इस पूरे घटनाक्रम का विश्लेषण Online News India के Editor-in-Chief Dharmendra Singh (धर्मेंद्र सिंह) ने किया है।


Questions continue over the detention, medical examination, FIR and release of journalist Rosy and other journalists in Delhi. Journalists and lawyers allege that several hours after being detained, their medical examination had still not been completed and they were being moved between different locations.

Journalist Rosy has alleged that during a protest against gyanesh kumar at Jantar Mantar, ACP Vivek Bhagat misbehaved with her and touched her inappropriately. She has also claimed that an FIR was not registered despite her complaint. Other journalists have alleged that they were assaulted during detention and that there was also a delay in conducting their medical examination.

In this Exclusive Ground Report, Online News India speaks to journalists, lawyers and people connected with the case. The report examines key questions: When will the detained journalists be released? Why has the MLC allegedly been delayed? Why has an FIR not yet been registered? What are the lawyers demanding inside the police station?

The allegations mentioned in this report are claims made by the individuals concerned and remain subject to investigation and the official police response.
The complete news analysis is presented by Dharmendra Singh, Editor-in-Chief of Online News India.
